violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: observed sausage gravy 6/30
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. CFM discarded sausage gravy

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking

violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: PIC Duties, Train Employees on Cook Temps
violations.observation: Employees are not aware of or are not monitoring the cook temperatures of time/temperature control for safety food.
violations.corrective_action: The Person in Charge or certified food manager shall be designating employees to monitor the cooking and reheating temperatures of time/temperature control for safety foods. The employees shall be trained in using a calibrated food thermometer to ensure the following foods are cooked and reheated as required: 1) Poultry, turkey, duck, and stuffed foods: cooked to an internal temperature of 165F for 15 seconds, 2) Beef and eggs for hot holding: cooked to an internal temperature of 155F for at least 15 seconds, 3) Pork, seafood, plant foods for hot holding, and eggs for immediate service: cooked to an internal temperature of 145F for at least 15 seconds, 4) Prepared and subsequently cooled foods reheated for hot holding to an internal temperature of 165F for at least 15 seconds, and 5) Commercially processed foods reheated for hot holding to an internal temperature of 135F for at least 15 seconds. EHS provided training and demonstration with a calibrated thermometer

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Observed raw chicken on the WIF floor
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. Pupuseria y Taqueria Mana (Inspection Date: 04/30/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: Observed knife used to cut lemons stored in the gap between the hand-sink and the ice machine
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. CFM washed, rinsed and sanitized knife and stored on top of the cutting board.
